comment: Snapshot-parity corpus (T28-01, issue #84; tracks #71). Each case names a source DOCX (repo-relative under e2e/fixtures/, or null for a from-scratch document) plus a deterministic edit sequence expressed as @xcrong/docx-editor-core AgentCommands. The bun test `packages/core/src/__tests__/document-roundtrip-parity.test.ts` runs every case twice through the exact headless save pipeline both adapters share (parseDocx -> executeCommands -> repackDocx/createDocx), normalizes volatile fields (timestamps, rsids, zip metadata), and asserts (a) both runs produce identical digests and (b) the digest matches `snapshot-digests.json`. To grow coverage, add an entry here and run `bun run snapshot:update`. NEVER compare raw bytes: createEmpty writes `new Date()` and JSZip stamps entry dates.
